_note: Lalbagh host cheat sheet — aligned to the Master Character & Clue Matrix.

gameplay_flow.name: Initial Alibis
steps: Gather in a circle. Read Script #1.
Every suspect (Players 1–8) introduces themselves and states their claimed alibi for 3:15–3:45 PM.
Investigators introduce themselves and note they hold whisper clues.

gameplay_flow.name: Whisper Mingling
steps: Blow whistle / call attention. Read Script #2.
Players mingle in small groups of 2–3 and trade rumor clues.

gameplay_flow.name: Final Accusation & Reveal
steps: Call everyone back. Read Script #3 (incident summary).
Hand out voting paper → Tally votes → Coconut Vendor confesses if needed!

setup: Hand each guest a sealed envelope containing their assigned card (Player 1 through 20).
Give everyone a name tag with their character title (e.g., "Player 8: Tender Coconut Vendor").

scripts.title: Round 1 — The Discovery
scripts.read_aloud: Welcome to Lalbagh Botanical Gardens! The flower show crowds are thinning, but we have a terrible tragedy. Basavanna has been found dead near the fruit rows—and a killer is standing in this circle right now. The critical window is 3:15 to 3:45 PM. Open your envelopes. Go around the circle, introduce your character, and if you are a suspect, state where you claim to have been during that window.

scripts.title: Round 2 — Information Exchange
scripts.read_aloud: Listen up! Everyone here knows something. Every single person holds a critical piece of information or rumor. You now have 20 minutes to form small gossip groups of 2 or 3 and trade your secret clues. Remember: only the killer is allowed to lie when asked direct questions. Everyone else must tell the truth about what they saw or heard!

scripts.title: Round 3 — The Summary & Accusation
scripts.read_aloud: Time is up! Park security just shared the working incident report: 'Basavanna was killed with a fruit-cutting blade during the afternoon rush. A Deccan Herald clipping about the Gandhinagar Diamond Smuggler—described as having a dark wrist tattoo—was found near the body. Witnesses place Basavanna confronting a fruit-cart vendor and trying to call the police. One coconut stall was reportedly unattended around 3:30 PM.'

accusation_steps: Give guests 3 minutes to debate their theories in the circle.
Hand out small scraps of paper and pens.
Have every guest write down the name of the person they believe is the killer.
Announce the suspect with the most votes. Have them step forward and state whether they are guilty!
If the group voted incorrectly, have the Tender Coconut Vendor step forward to confess to the crime!
